seam_bypass.instructions: Judging only the supplied changed-file list, diff hunks, and architecture excerpt: does the diff make a load-file format produce or render output outside the composer -> serializer -> emitter seam (for example reintroducing a fat writer that renders records directly, or bypassing LoadFileEmitter), or move format dispatch out of LoadFileOrchestrator? The EDRM-XML carve-out (XmlLoadFileWriter) is the only sanctioned exception.

criteria.true: The diff bypasses the seam for a non-XML format or breaks the orchestrator's dispatch ownership
criteria.false: The diff stays within the seam (or only touches the sanctioned EDRM-XML carve-out)

diagram_stale.instructions: Judging only the supplied changed-file list, diff hunks, and architecture excerpt: does the diff change component structure or data flow such that the docs/architecture.md diagrams or invariants are now inaccurate (stale), without the diff itself updating docs/architecture.md?

criteria.true: Structure changed and docs/architecture.md was not updated in the same diff
criteria.false: No structural change, or docs/architecture.md was updated in the same diff
